name: syndroo
description: Open-source publishing infrastructure for the social web.

SYNDROO_API_KEY.description: Choose a long random string. API clients send it as the Syndroo Bearer token.

BLUESKY_PASSWORD.description: A Bluesky app password. Do not use your main account password.

BLUESKY_HOST.description: The Bluesky PDS hostname. Use `bsky.social` for the default service.

THREADS_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A long-lived Threads user access token with `threads_basic` and `threads_content_publish`.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @syndroo/core && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/bluesky && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/threads
scripts.build:package: npm run build && npm run build:package --workspace @syndroo/cloudflare-worker
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:scripts && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @syndroo/core && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/bluesky && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/threads && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/cloudflare-worker
